results.title: Jaguar Beach‎
results.overview: In a remote region on the Pacific coast of Costa Rica, a lush landscape characterized by volcanoes meets tropical dry forest. Right there is a very special beach where two completely different species meet: sea turtles and jaguars. This has spectacular consequences for both sides and their environment. The two animals form an alliance that is as surprising as it is unintentional. The predator suddenly becomes a protector.

results.title: Endlich sichtbar – Von Vietnam nach Deutschland
results.original_title: Endlich sichtbar – Von Vietnam nach Deutschland
results.overview: Nguyen Trong Hieu is nicknamed the German Hot Guy. Especially the numerous female fans are crazy about the singer who calls himself (S)TRONG. In Vietnam, he is a superstar – and that as a German. His biggest dream is to become successful in his German homeland. We accompany his journey between two worlds, two careers, two identities, and at the same time immerse himself in the origin stories of the Vietnamese and Vietnamese living in Germany.

results.title: Zero Existence
results.overview: In a future dominated by digital corporations, Maya is a cyborg who offers alternative identities in the virtual afterlife. When she breaks the rules by granting freedom to her clients, she becomes a threat and is hunted down. On the run and searching for her lost daughter, she travels through artificial worlds and rebel communities, discovering that even digital paradise is ruled by control.

results.title: Die Noonautinnen
results.overview: Two psychologists embark on a journey to the deepest point of the collective subconscious. What will they find there… and are they prepared for it?

results.title: Reminiscence
results.overview: Eleonore and Jonas, an elderly couple, invite a real estate agent round to sell their flat. While Eleonore barely speaks, Jonas reminisces about their first encounter, which happened 60 years ago in this very flat.

results.title: Cousin
results.overview: Antón travels to his grandparents’ village to receive his first communion. There, while celebrating this special day with his family, a new way of seeing the world around him begins to take shape within him, leading to an experience that will forever mark the course of his life, as an individual, as a cousin, and as a child of God.

results.title: Venus sucks
results.overview: Yana is determined to leave her innocent days behind. Together with her sharp and shady friend Sheli, she sets out for an afternoon of mischief at the mall: in search of a blue movie, fast food, and male attention.  What begins as a light-hearted adventure slowly derails into a series of borderline encounters with strangers - and an unexpected lesson in the praises of the arts of seduction.

results.title: Limp
results.overview: When an old friend drops by with a broken heart, Max rises to the occasion… sorta.

results.title: Turning Point
results.overview: A mysterious package and a forgotten photo plunge Hugo back into his past, but the package contains something unexpected that could well change the course of his life.

results.title: Oysters Silence
results.overview: The film tells the story of a woman who lives in a village of mining workers.

results.title: Chasing Light
results.overview: After a fall wipes his memory, 13-year-old Max embarks on a journey to uncover his identity. But as memories resurface, he questions: are they his, or has someone shaped his past? Max's search may reveal a truth he's not ready to face.

results.title: Red Stars Upon the Field
results.overview: “If the ghosts can visit our time, we can visit theirs”. This freewheeling tour of German history of the 20th and 21st centuries follows a postmodern artist back to her East German village birthplace – where a discovered skeleton opens up mysteries both personal and political.

results.title: Florhood
results.overview: A woman in her 20s goes through a series of experiences in the city of New York that drive her to growth and self-love

results.title: Eterno
results.overview: A billionaire obsessed with reversing the aging process turns to an experimental treatment involving his own son.

results.title: Missing
results.overview: When the disappearance of a local girl overshadows the abduction of another, the guilt-ridden mother of the first girl takes it upon herself to uncover the truth, leading her into a dangerous web of jealousy, deception, and police corruption. This tense thriller explores the depths of a mother's love, the power of community, and the harsh realities of living under the spotlight of a small-town scandal.  —Janaya Black

results.title: I'm Not a Robot
results.overview: A music producer spirals into an existential crisis after repeatedly failing a CAPTCHA test-leading her to question whether she might actually be a robot.

results.title: Hate Thyself
results.overview: In this thriller story, devout detective Angelo Matteo and his partner Rufus engage in a raid, uncovering a gruesome scene of a serial killer's victims. As they investigate, Angelo's inner demons and questions about the nature of good and evil haunt him, leading to struggles with alcohol and strained relationships, including with his wife Ashley. Meanwhile, a disturbed individual named Ed Erdella picks up young men at bus stops and subjects them to horrifying torture. Angelo's pursuit of justice intensifies as he battles personal demons, seeks therapy, and uncovers a larger conspiracy involving missing persons. The story follows Angelo's journey to unravel the truth and bring the killer to justice while confronting his own inner turmoil.
